Permissive left from a left-only lane against 400 veh/h of opposing flow: 402 left turns an hour against 157 to 303 by the permitted-left method of [Fambro1991] (left turns only after the opposing queue clears, Drew's gap model with critical gap 4.5 to 5.1 s and turning headway 2.24 to 2.57 s, 0.88 to 2 sneakers a cycle). knownDeviation.followUp: Pending review. Repair: per-branch waiting at gates (the round-38 patch), together with the lane drop on the Martin Luther King Jr Way off-ramp (case i5).
knownDeviation.reason: New in round 38. A gate feeding a 3-lane link that forks into two branches with lanes of their own passes 0.43 of the free branch's flow while the other branch is queued back to the gate (offered 3,000 veh/h into a lane drop), measured against the same network with the other branch unqueued. Waiting trips leave a gate in order per first link, so trips for the free branch wait behind trips for the queued one. On the network this holds trips for the 52nd St off-ramp behind those for the Martin Luther King Jr Way off-ramp at the SR-24 mainline gate.
knownDeviation.relevance: Not reviewed: left to the project lead. A tested fix (a waiting trip waits only behind trips for the same fork branch) gives 0.64 and leaves every other case unchanged. On PM seeds 1 to 20 it cuts the trips waiting at the SR-24 gate from 143 to 84 and 68 per seed, but the fitted stations do not improve, and it changes the simulator fingerprint. So it was not landed.

knownDeviation.reason: New in round 32. Two-lane signal approach with 20% left turns, a 3-vehicle pocket that overflows every cycle and 500 veh/h per opposing lane: 792 veh/h per lane against 851 to 1,064, the b9 bound at 20% left, which applies the gap formula of [Brilon1999] with tc 4.1 s and tf 2.2 s to the hourly opposing flow. Round 33: the permitted-left method of [Fambro1991] (left turns only once the opposing queue has cleared, then gaps, then sneakers) puts the left-limited approach at 385 to 706 per lane, so the simulator's 792 is above that method, not below it; with the queue-first left-turn model (`Config::queue_first_left`, off by default) it is 658. Through drivers move around a waiting left-turner (lane changes along a link), and a left-turner that does not fit in the pocket waits at the stop line of the inner lane and turns from there.
knownDeviation.relevance: Not reviewed: left to the project lead. The range and the cited permitted-left method disagree; the expected range needs the lead's review before this case can say whether two-lane approaches with heavy permissive left turns are too slow or too fast.
